title: January is long: 45 days on one pay #Budget
text:
Many people are paid earlier in December, but January's pay comes at the normal time. Paid on 15 December, next pay on 29 January: that's 45 days on one pay, six and a half weeks instead of four. Standard Bank has called it the 49-day pay gap. And January isn't cheap: rent on the 1st, debit orders, and public schools open on 13 January 2027. In Debt Rescue's survey, more than a third said back-to-school costs were their biggest January worry.

About the example: an illustration; 15 Dec 2026 to 29 Jan 2027 = 45 days.

Full guide: "Festive Season on a Budget: How Not to Start January Broke (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
